title: Ink current
description: Indigo ink stretches into fine branching currents on pale paper.
useCase: Art direction for publications, printmaking, and quiet generative backgrounds.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. Analytic currents rather than a fluid/advection solver; no persistent pointer trail or velocity texture.
look: Full-bleed pale paper-grey field with large deep indigo ink pools, feathered edges and fine blue contour lines, like marbled paper.
motion: Indigo ink drifts very slowly through domain-warped noise while a local swirl twists back and forth on a roughly 48 s sine; the slider moves the swirl centre sideways.
adapt: The marbling is the `FRAGMENT` shader: `layered` is four-octave noise, the `q` warp sets turbulence, `a` the swirl strength and speed (`sin(u_time*.13)`), and `ink` and `edge` the thresholds; recolour the `vec3` values. Keep the WebGL lifecycle and reduced-motion branch.
